title: Weekly Radar数据来源覆盖改善
outOfScope: Do not redesign the user-facing report sections or expand confirmed-item presentation; that belongs to wi-weekly-radar-content-quality.
Do not change data, pending refs, publication receipts, archive retention, schedule cadence, or Telegram delivery.
Do not read, print, copy, or store Secret values, tokens, chat IDs, response bodies, or credentials.
Do not add paid APIs, LLM extraction, guessed provider endpoints, or provider-authority reinterpretation.
Do not generate ranking, system judgment, human judgment, trading conclusions, or capital-action recommendations.

sources.reason: Existing source collection, normalization, and source-availability boundary.
SEC company-facts and submissions source adapters currently reported as unavailable for all companies.
Finite HTTP limits, safe error mapping, redirect policy, and response-size boundary.
Configured company/source endpoint registry and provider-neutral configuration rules.
Runtime source status and availability facts carried into the report snapshot.
Existing user-facing source-status categories and rule against treating discovery as authority.
Existing source-adapter and HTTP safety tests that define the current behavior.
User-facing explanation of source availability and evidence limits.

riskAssessment.reason: Changing source availability semantics can mislead users about evidence coverage and must preserve safe network boundaries without exposing credentials or response data.
riskAssessment.reviewedBy: Codex after the user's acceptance of the source-coverage proposal

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: The user accepted a separate source-coverage Work Item; implementation remains within existing provider-neutral adapters and safe availability evidence.

synchronizationCheckpoint.reason: Synchronize this active Work Item to the merged WI-A base while preserving its owned governance evidence.

preReviewWarnings: Review configured-versus-unavailable-versus-not-applicable classification for every provider family.
Review that all failure evidence remains redacted and that no source is promoted from discovery to confirmed authority.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Runtime source status distinguishes at least configured and available, configured but unavailable, not configured, not applicable, and discovery-only states without collapsing them into one unavailable count.

SEC source results for the 10 configured companies expose a redacted, evidence-bound reason for unavailable results or a successful availability state; no response body, token, user-agent secret, or credential is persisted.

News, investor-relations, career, Greenhouse, and Lever source states distinguish missing configuration from request failure, empty result, unsupported provider, and discovery-only material where the existing boundary can establish the distinction.

Provider configuration uses only explicit, validated endpoints and preserves the existing finite HTTP limits, redirect policy, and safe error redaction; no guessed URLs or paid API dependency is introduced.
The source status facts remain compatible with the user-facing report and snapshot boundaries; this Work Item does not redesign report sections or change publication behavior.
Automated tests cover mixed source availability, SEC failure classification, absent job-provider configuration, empty results, oversized/error responses, and secret-safe diagnostics.
User-facing Weekly Radar documentation explains what each availability state means and what it does not prove.
guidelines: Never expose or persist Secret values, credentials, full response bodies, or sensitive request headers in source status or diagnostics.
Do not infer provider availability or evidence authority from a missing, empty, or discovery-only response.
Use explicit validated configuration; do not guess endpoints or silently add external dependencies.
Document source-status meanings for users without exposing implementation diagnostics.

intent.problem: The 2026-08-24 report contains 49 temporarily unavailable items and 29 not-configured items. SEC is unavailable for all 10 companies, while news, investor-relations, career, Greenhouse, and Lever states are aggregated too coarsely to tell a user whether a source is missing, failing, empty, unsupported, or discovery-only.
constraints: Preserve the existing evidence-first and provider-neutral architecture.
Do not read, print, store, or expose sensitive provider values, response bodies, or sensitive headers.
Do not treat discovery material as confirmed evidence or silently infer that an unavailable source means no company change.
Keep report presentation, delivery, data publication, and schedule cadence in their separate Work Items.
intent.rationale: A source-coverage correction should first make availability truthfully diagnosable using existing adapters and bounded errors; it should not hide gaps by adding unsupported sources or changing report semantics.

rawUserRequest: 接受关于 Weekly Radar 报告内容增强和数据覆盖拆分的建议；先开对应 WI，改善来源覆盖但保持证据和安全边界。

requestedOperation.authorityReason: The user accepted the proposed source-coverage improvement and requested the corresponding Work Item.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: SEC is configured but unavailable for a company.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The source status records a bounded redacted reason and never turns the failed request into a confirmed fact or a silent no-change conclusion.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add deterministic fixture responses for transport failure, non-success status, oversized body, malformed payload, and successful SEC metadata.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A career or job provider is not configured or is not applicable to a company.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Not configured, not applicable, and configured-but-unavailable remain distinct and no guessed endpoint is contacted.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Test explicit provider mappings, absent mappings, unsupported provider values, and empty configured results.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A discovery-only or unavailable source is included in the weekly status aggregation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The status remains useful to users while explicitly preserving the rule that discovery material is not conclusion evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add source-status aggregation tests and documentation assertions for the user-visible meanings and limits.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.
